mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.cover_file_id, a.author_id, a.category_id, a.status, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.is_top, a.is_recommend, a.visibility, a.comment_policy, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM article a WHERE a.deleted=0
AND a.status=#{criteria.status} AND a.category_id=#{criteria.categoryId} AND a.author_id=#{criteria.authorId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article_tag t WHERE t.article_id=a.id AND t.tag_id=#{criteria.tagId})
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY
COALESCE(a.publish_time, a.update_time, a.create_time) DESC, a.id DESC a.is_top DESC, COALESCE(a.publish_time, a.create_time) DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT FROM article a INNER JOIN
user_article_like user_article_favorite
relation ON relation.article_id=a.id AND relation.user_id=#{userId} WHERE a.deleted=0
ORDER BY relation.create_time DESC, relation.article_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET title=#{article.title}, summary=#{article.summary}, content=#{article.content}, content_html=NULL, cover_image=#{article.coverImage}, category_id=#{article.categoryId}, status=#{article.status}, visibility=#{article.visibility}, comment_policy=#{article.commentPolicy}, is_top=#{article.isTop}, is_recommend=#{article.isRecommend}, is_original=#{article.isOriginal}, original_url=#{article.originalUrl}, password=#{article.password}, publish_time=#{article.publishTime}, version=version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{article.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted=0
